config.label: Client ID of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection
config.description: Client ID of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection.

config.label: Client secret of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection
config.description: Client secret of your Xero Web app (Sign in with Xero) or Custom Connection.

config.label: Optional refresh token from Sign in with Xero, for a Web app
config.description: Optional refresh token from Sign in with Xero, for a Web app. Rebel saves it when you click Connect. With it, the client ID and secret are used as a Web app's, not a Custom Connection's.

config.label: Optional externally-managed Xero bearer token
config.description: Optional externally-managed Xero bearer token. When set, it takes precedence over the refresh token and the Custom Connection client credentials.
